⚠️  Breaking changes and upgrade notes 
 
  Host-only settings:  Repository  .pr_agent.toml  files can no longer override GitHub pacing and retry settings ( github.seconds_between_requests ,  github.seconds_between_writes ,  github.api_retries ,  github.ratelimit_retries ),  config.num_retries ,  azure_devops_server.agent_identity , custom-label settings ( config.enable_custom_labels  and  [custom_labels] ), or  pr_code_suggestions.max_number_of_calls .  config.num_retries  is capped at 10. Per-directory  .pr_agent.toml  files also cannot set  pr_code_suggestions.dual_publishing_score_threshold . Move values you rely on to host configuration. ( #4445 ,  #4475 ,  #4485 ,  #4632 ,  #4745 ) 
  Comment arguments:   config.ai_timeout  and  pr_code_suggestions.max_number_of_calls  can no longer be set through command comments. ( #4445 ) 
  Removed no-op settings:   pr_code_suggestions.approve_pr_on_self_review  and  pr_code_suggestions.fold_suggestions_on_self_review  are removed from the shipped configuration. PR-Agent warns if they remain set; they never changed  /improve  behavior. ( #4598 ) 
  Custom provider integrations:  Unused provider methods and capability names were removed. Review  #4691  if a custom provider calls those internal methods. 
  Auto-approval:   config.enable_auto_approval  is now host-only. The auto-approval path remains disabled in this release. ( #4700 ) 
 
 🔐 Trusted Publishing 
 PyPI releases now use PyPI Trusted Publishing through GitHub Actions OIDC and produce package attestations. The release workflow rejects commits that are not reachable from  main . ( #3909 )

⚠️ Breaking Changes Warning This release changes several defaults and makes more settings host-only. Check each item below against your deployment before upgrading. pip install pr-agent no longer installs the git provider SDKs ( #3679 ): PyGithub, python-gitlab, atlassian-python-api, the Azure DevOps SDKs, boto3, giteapy, the Google Cloud SDKs and a2a-sdk moved to the github , gitlab , bitbucket , azure , codecommit , gitea , google and mosaico extras. Install the ones you use, for example pip install "pr-agent[github]" , or pr-agent[all] for the previous set. The Docker images already install all . Docker service images run as a non-root user ( #3910 ): the webhook, app, polling and Mosaico targets run as UID/GID 10001 with HOME=/home/pragent . Mounted secrets must be readable by that user, output and database directories must be writable, and home-relative mounts should move to /home/pragent . The GitHub Action, CLI and Lambda images still run as root. Azure DevOps and Bitbucket Server webhooks require credentials ( #3911 ): with azure_devops_server.webhook_username / webhook_password or bitbucket_server.webhook_secret unset, every webhook is rejected with HTTP 403. Set them on both the sender and PR-Agent before upgrading. GitLab webhooks backed by a secret provider need a new token format ( #3913 ): when GitLab credentials come from AWS Secrets Manager or Google Cloud Storage, the webhook's Secret Token must be : . Name-only tokens are rejected with HTTP 401, so update the webhooks when you deploy. Namespace-wide settings are off by default ( #3908 ): PR-Agent no longer applies /pr-agent-settings to every repository automatically. Set the host-only config.global_settings_repo = "pr-agent-settings" to keep the old behaviour. [tool.pr-agent] in pyproject.toml is no longer read ( #3941 ): move those settings to .pr_agent.toml . More settings are host-only ( #3840 , #3904 , #3950 , #4001 , #4054 ): a repository's .pr_agent.toml and comment arguments can no longer set provider endpoints ( openai.api_base and the other api_base keys), keys ending in url , endpoint , org , key , token or secret , provider auth mode and TLS settings ( github.deployment_type , gitlab.auth_type / ssl_verify , bitbucket.auth_type , gitea.skip_ssl_verification / ssl_ca_cert ), jira.jira_site / jira_api_email / project_keys , or LiteLLM callbacks. They are ignored with a warning, so set them in host configuration instead. Comment arguments are restricted further as well ( #3902 ). Gitea and Gerrit read repository settings from the target branch ( #3906 ): Gitea uses the PR base and Gerrit the default branch, so a .pr_agent.toml change inside a PR no longer applies to that PR. Cross-repository reads need an allowlist ( #3922 , #3897 ): GitHub ticket context only reads linked issues and sub-issues from the PR's own repository or same-owner repositories listed in config.repo_context_sibling_repos . gitlab.expand_submodule_diffs only expands submodules listed there that sit in the MR's top-level group. Ignore rules now cover comment commands ( #3943 ): config.ignore_pr_authors , ignore_pr_labels , ignore_pr_title , the branch rules and ignore_repositories now skip manually triggered commands too, not only automatic ones. merge_recommendation values were renamed ( #4010 ): with pr_reviewer.require_merge_recommendation on, safe_to_merge is now no_concerns_found and merge_with_caution is now needs_review . changes_required is unchanged. Update anything that parses review output. /describe comments no longer repeat the PR description ( #4118 ): with pr_description.publish_description_as_comment = true , the comment leaves out the User Description section even when add_original_user_description is on, because the PR body is left untouched. Smaller behaviour changes : webhook servers reject request bodies over 5 MiB with HTTP 413 ( config.max_webhook_request_body_bytes , #3820 ). A positive config.max_output_tokens below 4096 is raised to 4096 ( #4013 ). /describe and /generate_labels drop model labels outside the PR types and enabled custom labels ( #3899 ). ⚠️  Important Changes 
 
  Gitea webhooks now require a secret  ( #3637 ): with  gitea.webhook_secret  unset, the Gitea app rejects every webhook with HTTP 403 instead of accepting it unsigned. Set the secret on the Gitea webhook and in your config before upgrading. 
  The GitHub Action fails on tool errors  ( #3712 ): a tool failure that used to be logged and swallowed now fails the Action. Set  github_action_config.fail_on_tool_errors = false  to keep the old green behaviour. 
  Comment commands need a leading  /  on GitLab, Bitbucket and Bitbucket Server  ( #3769 ): a comment only runs a tool when it starts with a slash command, so plain comments that mention one no longer trigger anything. 
   extra_config_url  is host-only  ( #3638 ): a repository's  .pr_agent.toml  can no longer set it. Configure it on the host instead, for example with  PR_AGENT_EXTRA_CONFIG_URL . 
   commitable_code_suggestions  is now  committable_code_suggestions   ( #3749 ): the old spelling still works with a deprecation warning until 1.0. 
  The Bitbucket Server webhook image runs under gunicorn  ( #3667 ): the container now starts multiple workers through the shared  gunicorn_config.py  instead of a single Python process. 
 
  Known issue:  Bedrock Kimi K3, new in this release ( #3651 ), still receives a temperature by default, which Bedrock is reported to reject. Until  #3752  lands, add the model ids to  config.no_temperature_models .

⚠️  Important Changes 
 
  GitHub App webhooks now require a configured secret  ( #2595 ):  get_body()  no longer accepts unsigned webhooks — a deployment without  GITHUB.WEBHOOK_SECRET  set is rejected with HTTP 403 instead of trusting every caller. Set the secret on your GitHub App and in your config before upgrading. The same PR escapes attacker-controlled webhook fields that were interpolated into CLI command strings. 
  Dependency management migrated to  uv   ( #2509 ):  requirements.txt ,  requirements-dev.txt , and the legacy  setup.py  are gone — dependencies now live in  pyproject.toml  with a committed  uv.lock . Set up a dev environment with  uv sync  and run tools via  uv run . Optional features are now extras ( lambda ,  langchain  —  uv sync --extra <name> ) or a dependency group ( similar-issue  —  uv sync --group similar-issue ), and Docker images install from the lockfile with  uv sync --frozen . Installing from PyPI with  pip install pr-agent  still works. 
  Linting consolidated on Ruff  ( #2880 ): flake8 and the standalone isort pre-commit hook were removed. Contributors should run  uv run ruff check --fix  on touched files before committing. 
  Dependency pins relaxed to patched ranges  ( #2881 ): exact pins were loosened so downstream consumers can pick up security updates; LiteLLM was also upgraded to v1.98.0 ( #2794 ).
